QuestInfo.name: [Ghost Park] Korean Folk Town's New Park!
QuestInfo.0: Spiegelmann has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.1: Spiegelmann has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.2: Spiegelmann has constructed a new theme park in Korean Folk Town called #bGhost Park#k. You can go to Ghost Park through the top right of Korean Folk Town.

0.0: Why, hello!\r\nI am #bSpiegelmann#k, the master of Monster Park.
0.1: #bGhost Park#k is my newest theme park, right here in Korean Folk Town!
0.2: It's a creepy place where you can meet the ghosts of Korean Folk Town. There are some #bspecial rules#k for this place as well! Ha ha ha...
0.3: If you're interested, go right from #bKorean Folk Town#k!

yes.0: Heh, then I'll be waiting for you in... GHOOOOOST PAAAAARK woooooo...

no.0: Huh? Aren't you interested in my newest theme park? Isn't everyone?
